description: Frontend (Flutter): consume the FEAT-001 API to add the USER/TRAINER account-type selector in the Midnight Energy auth UI (optional referral field for USER only), trainer referral-code management in Trainer Profile (Copy + Change/Generate New + custom-code Check Availability/Save + live Total Students), connect-after-registration from the student Profile 'My Trainer' section with the switch/reject flow, plus the data-layer methods/models and all Flutter widget tests. Depends on FEAT-001 (API contract: /api/auth/register-trainer, /api/trainer/referral-code*, /api/student/connect-trainer, confirmSwitch). Grounded in the real files read during exploration (register_screen.dart, auth_controller.dart, trainer_profile_screen.dart, profile_screen.dart, auth_repository.dart, trainer_repository.dart, trainer_models.dart).
steps: Extend data layers: in frontend/lib/features/auth/data/auth_repository.dart add registerTrainer(name) -> POST /api/auth/register-trainer and add optional confirmSwitch (default false) to linkTrainer. In frontend/lib/features/trainer/data/trainer_repository.dart add getReferralCode(), generateReferralCode(), setCustomReferralCode(code), checkAvailability(code), connectTrainer(code,{confirmSwitch}) each returning Result<T> and parsing the {success,data} envelope like existing methods (ApiClient already exposes get/post/patch). In frontend/lib/features/trainer/data/trainer_models.dart add ReferralCodeInfo{code,active,updatedAt}, AvailabilityResult{available,reason}, and ConnectResult (superset of LinkTrainerResult carrying reason:'already_linked' + currentTrainer/requestedTrainer).

Add the account-type selector to frontend/lib/features/auth/presentation/register_screen.dart: a local _AccountType (default user) rendered as a segmented control / two selectable cards above the form, built from existing AppColors/AppSpacing with an obvious selected state (Midnight Energy look). USER: unchanged form incl. optional referral field + existing linkTrainerControllerProvider flow. TRAINER: hide the referral field; after a successful register() fire a new RegisterTrainerController.register(name). Add RegisterTrainerController + registerTrainerControllerProvider on the root container in frontend/lib/features/auth/providers/auth_controller.dart (analogous to LinkTrainerController) so the call outlives the torn-down register screen. No router change (role resolves to trainer on next verify).

Extend the _ReferralCard in frontend/lib/features/trainer/presentation/trainer_profile_screen.dart: keep Copy; add a 'Change / Generate New' action opening a bottom sheet with 'Generate a new code' (generateReferralCode) and 'Choose a custom code' (field + Check Availability -> checkAvailability showing live checkmark Available / cross Taken / format error, then Save -> setCustomReferralCode). On success invalidate trainerProfileProvider and show a SnackBar. Surface the live Total Students value (profile.totalStudents is already the live backend count) on the card/Account section. Card reads the code dynamically from TrainerProfile.referralCode.

Extend _MyTrainerSection in frontend/lib/features/profile/presentation/profile_screen.dart: in the MyTrainer.none state add a 'Connect to Trainer' affordance opening a sheet (code field -> connectTrainer); on invalid_code show 'Invalid trainer referral code'; on already_linked show a switch dialog ('You're connected to {currentTrainer.name}. Switch to {requestedTrainer.name}?' with [Cancel] [Switch Trainer]; degrade name to 'your current trainer' when null) that re-calls connectTrainer(confirmSwitch:true); on success show 'Connected to {trainer}' and invalidate myTrainerProvider. Connected state unchanged. Empty code -> no call.

Add/extend Flutter widget tests: NEW frontend/test/account_type_selector_test.dart (USER shows referral field, TRAINER hides it); NEW frontend/test/trainer_referral_manage_test.dart (change/generate updates the displayed code via overridden providers); NEW frontend/test/connect_trainer_test.dart (invalid/already-linked/switch outcomes); extend frontend/test/trainer_routing_test.dart (register-as-trainer routes to the trainer shell). Update frontend/test/trainer_routing_test.dart, trainer_dashboard_test.dart, register_referral_test.dart to use arbitrary trainer names/codes instead of the single 'Dream Physics'/'dreamphysics' fixture.

Run the frontend verification gate; confirm the Add-Food frontend fix (add_food_sheet_test.dart, food_model_test.dart) stays green; commit scoped frontend lib + test files only (never git add -A; leave the large untracked baseline alone).
acceptance_criteria: Running `cd c:\Users\cheta\OneDrive\Desktop\fit\frontend && flutter analyze` reports no errors and `flutter test` passes with all new/updated tests green.
The registration screen shows a USER/TRAINER selector before account creation; the referral field is visible for USER and hidden for TRAINER (asserted by account_type_selector_test.dart).
The Trainer Profile referral card supports Copy, Generate New, and custom-code Check Availability/Save, and updates the displayed code on success (asserted by trainer_referral_manage_test.dart).

The student Profile 'My Trainer' section can connect by code and shows invalid / already-linked (switch dialog) / connected outcomes (asserted by connect_trainer_test.dart); switching re-calls with confirmSwitch:true.
No production Dart contains a hardcoded 'dreamphysics' literal; the referral code is always read from backend responses; updated fixtures use arbitrary names/codes.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED on feat/trainer-student-2way (frontend repo). Gate green: `flutter analyze` -> No issues found; `flutter test` -> all 122 tests pass, incl. the Add-Food regression (add_food_sheet_test.dart, food_model_test.dart) which stayed green and untouched. No hardcoded 'dreamphysics' literal in any production Dart.

=== WHAT LANDED (consumes FEAT-001 API contract) ===
DATA LAYER:
- auth_repository.dart: LinkTrainerResult extended with alreadyLinked/switched/currentTrainer/requestedTrainer (+ new LinkTrainerRef{trainerId,name?}; name may be null -> UI degrades to 'your current trainer'). linkTrainer() gained optional confirmSwitch (sent only when true). New registerTrainer(name) -> POST /api/auth/register-trainer returning RegisterTrainerResult{trainerId, referralCode?}.
- trainer_models.dart: new ReferralCodeInfo{code?,active,updatedAt} (parses data.referralCode envelope: code/active/referralCodeUpdatedAt), AvailabilityResult{available,reason?}.
- trainer_repository.dart: new getReferralCode/generateReferralCode/setCustomReferralCode(code)/checkAvailability(code) and connectTrainer(code,{confirmSwitch}) -> POST /api/student/connect-trainer. ConnectResult is a typedef = LinkTrainerResult (connect-trainer is the backend's thin alias of link-trainer, identical shape). All parse the {success,data} envelope via ApiClient and return Result<T>; backend 422/400/409 surface as Failure.

PROVIDERS (auth_controller.dart): new RegisterTrainerController + registerTrainerControllerProvider on the ROOT container (analogous to LinkTrainerController) so the register-trainer call outlives the torn-down register screen; a transport failure leaves the account a plain student (null state), never blocks registration. (trainer_providers.dart) new trainerReferralCodeProvider (FutureProvider<ReferralCodeInfo>) for direct code reads if needed.

UI:
- register_screen.dart: _AccountType {user(default),trainer} selector = two selectable cards (keys accountType_user/accountType_trainer) with an obvious selected state (primary border+tint+check), built from AppColors/AppSpacing (Midnight Energy). USER: unchanged form + optional referral field + existing linkTrainerControllerProvider flow. TRAINER: referral field HIDDEN; on successful register() fires registerTrainerControllerProvider.register(name). No router change (role resolves to trainer on next verify). Also hardened a pre-existing narrow-width overflow in the 'Already have an account?' row (wrapped the label in Flexible) so the register screen lays out at the 460px auth-column width.
- trainer_profile_screen.dart: _ReferralCard now reads the code dynamically from TrainerProfile.referralCode (shows 'No code yet' when absent), keeps Copy, and adds a 'Change / Generate new' (or 'Create a code') action opening _ReferralManageSheet: 'Generate a new code' (generateReferralCode) OR custom code (field key customReferralField + 'Check availability' -> live Available/Taken/reserved/invalid message + checkmark/cross, then 'Save' -> setCustomReferralCode). On success invalidates trainerProfileProvider + SnackBar. Total Students is the live backend count already surfaced in the Account section (profile.totalStudents).
- profile_screen.dart _MyTrainerSection: the unlinked state is now a tappable 'Connect to a trainer' tile opening _ConnectTrainerSheet (field key connectReferralField; empty -> no call). invalid_code -> SnackBar 'Invalid trainer referral code'; already_linked -> switch AlertDialog ('You're connected to {current}. Switch to {requested}?' [Cancel]/[Switch Trainer]; null current name -> 'your current trainer') that re-calls connectTrainer(confirmSwitch:true); success -> 'Connected to {trainer}' + invalidate myTrainerProvider. Connected state unchanged.

TESTS: NEW account_type_selector_test.dart, trainer_referral_manage_test.dart, connect_trainer_test.dart (invalid/connected/switch-confirm/switch-cancel/null-name). Extended trainer_routing_test.dart with a register-as-trainer -> trainer-shell test. Updated trainer_routing_test.dart / trainer_dashboard_test.dart / register_referral_test.dart fixtures off 'Dream Physics'/'dreamphysics' to arbitrary names/codes (Coach Mina, Coach Rahul, GYMRAHUL45, FITCHE123, TRN8X3Q, FIT7K2P9).

NOTES for later steps: connect_trainer_test pumps the full ProfileScreen, so it overrides sharedPreferencesProvider (themeModeProvider dep), profileProvider(null), authStateProvider, gameSummaryProvider, trainerRepositoryProvider. ConnectResult==LinkTrainerResult (same JSON). DEVIATIONS from the approved design: none.
